title: Arrangers, then birth, family, teacher McCollum and brass band funerals
summary: One long block: the band's arrangers and soloists, then Alcorn's 1912 birth in New Orleans, his musical family, teacher George McCollum, and old brass band funerals and clarinetists. It cannot be divided.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs
